name: vwap_zscore_bounce_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's VWAP z-score crosses ±2.0 sigma, the index is at a statistically rare deviation from session VWAP — a level where TWAP/VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms (mutual fund block desks, FII VWAP execution) start getting significantly worse fills relative to their benchmark. This creates mechanical reversal pressure: at z < −2.0, TWAP buy orders accelerate (buying cheap vs. benchmark), injecting demand that arrests the selloff; at z > +2.0, TWAP sell orders accelerate, capping the rally. At 5-second resolution we detect the exact bar where z-score begins turning back from its extreme (zscore_delta3 sign flip), entering the reversion within the first 15 seconds rather than waiting for a full 1-minute confirmation bar on the original timeframe.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset per session
indicators.purpose: Session cumulative VWAP — no bar-size scaling needed as it is inherently time-independent. Same concept at 5s as at 1-min: accumulated price-volume average from 09:15.

indicators.name: vwap_dev
indicators.purpose: Raw deviation from session VWAP in index points. Feeds the rolling normalizer below.

indicators.name: vwap_dev_std
indicators.purpose: Rolling 30-minute (360 bars × 5s) standard deviation of VWAP deviations — SAME 30-min window as original (STDEV(vwap_dev, 30) on 1-min bars). This is NOT scaled blindly; 30 minutes is the correct session-regime window regardless of bar size: it captures how much NIFTY typically deviates from VWAP TODAY without becoming stale. Shorter windows (e.g., 5 min) would be too noisy; longer would miss intraday regime shifts.

indicators.name: vwap_zscore
indicators.purpose: Normalized VWAP deviation. Threshold ±2.0 corresponds to the 5% tail of deviations — the zone where institutional flow reversal is mechanical rather than discretionary.

indicators.name: zscore_delta3
indicators.purpose: 15-second rate-of-change of z-score. Replaces the original's single-bar '> prev bar' turning confirmation. At 5s, a 3-bar (15s) window filters false turns from 5-second noise while still capturing the reversion onset far earlier than a 1-minute bar would. A positive delta3 after z < −2.0 means the extreme is definitively behind us.

buy_ce.confirmation: zscore_delta3 > 0 — z-score has already begun reverting at entry bar, not just touched the threshold

buy_pe.confirmation: zscore_delta3 < 0 — z-score already reversing before we enter

exit.stop_rationale: A NIFTY 2-sigma VWAP deviation typically spans 25-40 spot points. If the reversion thesis is correct, NIFTY should not move an additional 8 spot points against the position within the first 30 seconds of entry. 4 option points (≈8 spot pts at delta 0.5) grants enough room for normal 5-second volatility noise while cutting the trade if the trend is overwhelming the TWAP reversal.
exit.target_rationale: Median first-leg reversion from a 2-sigma NIFTY VWAP deviation covers 20-30 spot points. Targeting 6 option points (≈12 spot pts) captures 40-50% of the expected move — the fastest, most reliable portion before momentum fades and re-entries by opposite-side TWAP orders stall the bounce. Gives 1:1.5 R:R vs. the 4-point stop.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 24 — above 24 NIFTY moves too violently for 2-sigma to mark a reliable extreme; z-score means less when realized vol is in a spike regime
filters.time_filter: 09:30–15:20 IST; skip first 15 min (09:15–09:30) for VWAP stabilization with enough price-volume history
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy at 5s; VWAP already incorporates volume weighting
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy is counter-trend by design; strong trends are handled by stop_points
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit order execution at candle close

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — VWAP benchmarking by institutions is a structural feature of Indian equity markets; will persist as long as SEBI-regulated mutual funds use VWAP benchmarks

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Universe shifted from NIFTY 100 stocks to the NIFTY index itself — index is far more liquid, smoother, and more directly driven by institutional TWAP flow. (2) Lookback for vwap_dev_std kept at 30 minutes (360 bars) — same time window as original's STDEV(30 on 1-min) because session-regime volatility is the correct denominator at any bar size. (3) Confirmation changed from a single-bar z-score turn to a 3-bar (15s) zscore_delta3 — finer detection enabled by 5s bars. The VIX filter is unchanged from original (< 24). Volume surge filter dropped: index volume at 5s is too noisy to be informative.
weaknesses: Z-score calculation requires ~10 bars minimum and ideally 360 bars (30 min) for a stable std; early-session signals are lower quality despite the 09:30 session start
In persistent trending sessions (e.g., post-budget, FOMC nights), z-score can breach ±2.0 and keep going — the TWAP reversal pressure may not overcome directional institutional demand
Rolling std can compress in low-volatility sessions, making z-score thresholds easier to breach on smaller absolute deviations than the strategy intends
